svg.title: Hildegard of Bingen: Imperial eagle
svg.desc: Attested emblem. A single-headed eagle for the Holy Roman Empire in which Hildegard lived. This uses the medieval imperial symbol rather than her book and flame. The later double-headed imperial eagle is deliberately avoided; the green and vellum remain game colors. Colors follow the game palette, with darker banner ink where needed for contrast; not historical flag colors.
